title: Business & Commerce Code, Chapter 17, Subchapter E (Deceptive Trade Practices-Consumer Protection Act)
verified_how: Fetched https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/BC/htm/BC.17.htm: 'SUBCHAPTER E. DECEPTIVE TRADE PRACTICES AND CONSUMER PROTECTION' runs from Sec. 17.41 to Sec. 17.63. Sec. 17.41 reads 'This subchapter may be cited as the Deceptive Trade Practices-Consumer Protection Act.'
notes: The main consumer protection statute (DTPA), including the private consumer remedy and treble damages.
